purpose: Further Bonsai 2 27B CPU kernel and Adreno Vulkan hypotheses

runtime.note: Patched binaries retain the base build_commit label; identify the variant by filename and SHA256.
runtime.hostBuildFix: In vulkan-shaders/CMakeLists.txt: project("vulkan-shaders-gen" CXX), set(CMAKE_BUILD_WITH_INSTALL_RPATH ON). No runtime algorithm change.
runtime.affinityRetry: Only the variant with suffix -retry contains the previously saved Android EINVAL retry patch.

limitations: Standalone processes run as ADB shell; installed APK and its CPU runtime were not replaced.
GPU model benchmarks are short, one measured sample per configuration, with changing thermal and cache state; they are not app TTFT or context-4096 acceptance tests.
Benchmarks wait for CPU7 maximum frequency >=98% nominal and hottest compute zone <=47C. GPU clocks were not locked. sysfs gpuclk was not readable.
Thermal helper keys ending in Hz contain the raw cpufreq sysfs values, which are kHz on this device.
Process VmRSS excludes much of GPU allocation. GpuTotal in meminfo is a system-wide value, not exclusive to the benchmark.
CPU microbenchmarks use one pinned CPU3, synthesized exactly representable ternary weights, fixed activations and rotating kernel order; speed ratios are not whole-model speedups.

PQ2 Q8_K uses different activation quantization from Q8_0. The later full-model experiment repacks all ternary weights exactly and compares all other tensors byte-for-byte; only a short text smoke test is used, not a broad quality evaluation.
The initial GPU Hadamard operation filter FWHT selected no Hadamard tests; corrected follow-up explicitly used MUL_MAT_HADAMARD.

pq2Repack.headerRecipe:
import json, struct
from pathlib import Path
manifest = json.loads(Path('pq2-repack-manifest.json').read_text())
# The manifest records every type position and new tensor offset.
# Copy original metadata and tensor descriptors, then update only those fields.
import sys
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3] / 'tools'))
from pin_model import GgufReader, read_value
with open(manifest['input'], 'rb') as f:
    r = GgufReader(f)
    assert r.read(4) == b'GGUF'
    version, tensors, metadata = r.unpack('<IQQ')
    for _ in range(metadata):
        key = r.string(); typ, = r.unpack('<I'); position = f.tell()
        value = read_value(r, typ)
        if key == 'general.file_type':
            assert typ == 4 and value == 143
            file_type_position = position
    f.seek(0); header = bytearray(f.read(manifest['dataStart']))
struct.pack_into('<I', header, file_type_position, 141)
for tensor in manifest['tensors']:
    struct.pack_into('<IQ', header, tensor['typePosition'], 142 if tensor['type']==143 else tensor['type'], tensor['newOffset'])
with open(manifest['output'], 'xb') as f:
    f.write(header); f.truncate(manifest['newBytes'])
with open('pq2-repack-records.bin', 'wb') as f:
    for t in manifest['tensors']:
        f.write(struct.pack('<QQQQ', manifest['dataStart']+t['oldOffset'], manifest['dataStart']+t['newOffset'], t['elements'], t['type']))
